items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The transcript mentions 'Barney and Dottie' reminiscing, but the interviewee (Zutty Singleton) does not speak about a personal relationship with Dottie in the provided context.

ctx.x: They are reminiscing. And Barney and Dottie told Lucille about how they enjoyed
the tape. They played it for us and Lucille said she's got to get it, she's got to get it.
